components.name: Primary Button (Olive Tab)
components.description: The booking action: olive tab with a gold keyline and an inset second keyline.
components.css: .ds-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.6em;min-height:48px;padding:.75rem 1.5rem;border:1px solid var(--btn-line);border-radius:2px;background:var(--btn-bg);color:var(--btn-fg);font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif;font-size:.9375rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;text-decoration:none;line-height:1.2;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 320ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1),color 320ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1),transform 180ms ease;}.ds-btn:active{transform:translateY(1px);}.ds-btn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #c09a58;outline-offset:3px;}.ds-btn-primary{--btn-bg:#6b705c;--btn-fg:#fafaed;--btn-line:#c09a58;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px var(--btn-bg),inset 0 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb,#c09a58 55%,transparent);}.ds-btn-primary:hover{--btn-bg:#4a503d;}

components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;height:72px;padding:0 24px;background:#0e3b43;border-bottom:1px solid #2a5a63;font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif;}.ds-nav-brand{display:flex;flex-direction:column;margin-right:auto;font:600 1.3rem/1 Cinzel,serif;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#fafaed;}.ds-nav-brand small{margin-top:4px;font:600 .6875rem 'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#c09a58;}.ds-nav a{position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px;padding:0 12px;font-size:.8125rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;text-decoration:none;color:#c9d3cf;}.ds-nav a::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:12px;right:12px;bottom:8px;height:1px;background:#c09a58;transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:transform 320ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);}.ds-nav a:hover,.ds-nav a[aria-current='page']{color:#fafaed;}.ds-nav a:hover::after,.ds-nav a[aria-current='page']::after{transform:scaleX(1);}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #c09a58;outline-offset:3px;}

components.name: Gold Double-Rule Frame
components.description: Label window: nested octagons (1px gold, 4px ground, 1px gold, 4px ground, picture), 18px cut.
components.css: .ds-frame,.ds-g,.ds-r,.ds-pic{clip-path:polygon(var(--c) 0,calc(100% - var(--c)) 0,100% var(--c),100% calc(100% - var(--c)),calc(100% - var(--c)) 100%,var(--c) 100%,0 calc(100% - var(--c)),0 var(--c));}.ds-frame{--c:18px;width:280px;aspect-ratio:4/3;padding:1px;background:#c09a58;}.ds-g{--c:calc(18px - 0.41px);height:100%;padding:4px;background:#fafaed;}.ds-r{--c:calc(18px - 2.07px);height:100%;padding:1px;background:#c09a58;}.ds-g2{--c:calc(18px - 2.48px);}.ds-pic{--c:calc(18px - 4.14px);height:100%;background:#0e3b43;}

components.name: Label Panel
components.description: Cream paper with 24px octagon cut and an inner gold hairline octagon 8px in.
components.css: .ds-panel,.ds-panel::before,.ds-panel::after{clip-path:polygon(var(--c) 0,calc(100% - var(--c)) 0,100% var(--c),100% calc(100% - var(--c)),calc(100% - var(--c)) 100%,var(--c) 100%,0 calc(100% - var(--c)),0 var(--c));}.ds-panel{--c:24px;position:relative;isolation:isolate;max-width:360px;padding:2.25rem;background:#fafaed;color:#1c2426;font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif;}.ds-panel::before,.ds-panel::after{content:'';position:absolute;z-index:-1;pointer-events:none;}.ds-panel::before{--c:calc(24px - 3.31px);inset:8px;background:#c09a58;}.ds-panel::after{--c:calc(24px - 3.73px);inset:9px;background:#fafaed;}.ds-panel h3{margin:0 0 .5em;font:600 1.5rem/1.15 Cinzel,serif;color:#0e3b43;}.ds-panel p{margin:0;}

components.description: Dish name, dotted gold leader, tabular teal price, slate description.
components.css: .ds-dish{max-width:420px;padding:20px 0;border-bottom:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,#c09a58 45%,transparent);font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif;}.ds-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;column-gap:12px;align-items:baseline;}.ds-name{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:10px;font:600 1.25rem/1.3 Cinzel,serif;color:#1c2426;}.ds-name::after{content:'';flex:1;min-width:24px;border-bottom:1px dotted color-mix(in srgb,#c09a58 80%,transparent);transform:translateY(-4px);}.ds-price{font-weight:600;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums lining-nums;color:#0e3b43;}.ds-dish p{margin:6px 0 0;font-size:.9375rem;color:#5a6b70;}

narrative.overview:
The site is lithographed, not photographed-and-overlaid. Every surface is either a solid Aegean-teal tin field or a sheet of cream label paper, and the two alternate down the page the way a printed tin wraps its label. On those fields sit the label's printed furniture: ancient-gold double rules with cut octagonal corners, Greek meander bands as borders, an oval gold 1907 seal, and dotted price leaders. Photographs only ever appear inside gold-framed label windows.

Density is calm and generous: long section padding, one idea per band, copy held to a reading measure. The display voice is Cinzel set in capitals (GFS Didot, uppercased, for Greek); the working voice is Plus Jakarta Sans (Commissioner for Greek). Colour is flat and solid. There is no glass, no gradient, no emoji. The site refuses the category default of a full-bleed food photo under a dark overlay with a centred script headline.

Motion is printing, not performance: the hero label prints once (outer gold rule, inner rule, photo) and the seal stamps once; everything else rises in with a short fade on section entry. Under reduced motion it is all static.
keyCharacteristics: Solid teal tin fields alternating with cream label paper; never a gradient between them.
Gold double-rule octagon frames around every photograph.
Meander bands as printed borders at the edges of tin fields.
The oval 1907 seal as the one stamped mark per view.
Cinzel capitals for display; Plus Jakarta Sans for everything you read or press.
Square-shouldered tabs (2px) for buttons, chips, badges and fields.

rules.name: The Two Fields Rule
rules.body: Every band is either solid teal tin or solid cream paper (or their deep variants). No photo backgrounds, no overlays, no gradients.

rules.name: The Gold Is Ink Rule
rules.body: Ancient Gold draws rules, borders, ornaments and marks. When gold must carry small text on cream, use Gold Ink instead.

rules.name: The Olive Means Book Rule
rules.body: Olive fills are reserved for the booking action and its echoes; nothing decorative is olive.

rules.name: The Greek Capitals Rule
rules.body: Under `lang="el"`, display headings and drawer links are set in GFS Didot capitals with 0.035em tracking, letting the browser drop the tonos accents as Greek typesetting requires.

rules.name: The Display-Is-Display Rule
rules.body: Cinzel sets headings, the brand name, the seal and the hero lockup line only. Paragraphs, prices, buttons and form text are always the body face.

rules.name: The Printed Depth Rule
rules.body: Panels, frames and cards never take a shadow; they are printed on the field. Shadows belong only to things that float (seal, dropdown, sticky bar).

rules.name: The Parallel Diagonals Rule
rules.body: A nested octagon's cut is the outer cut minus inset x 0.414; never eyeball it, or the double rule pinches at the corners.

dos: Do alternate solid teal tin and cream paper bands; use the deep variants to separate two neighbouring bands of the same field.
Do put every photograph in the gold double-rule octagon frame, with its gap matching the band behind it.
Do set prices with a dotted gold leader and tabular lining numerals in teal.
Do use Gold Ink, not Ancient Gold, for any small text on cream.
Do keep buttons, chips, badges and fields as square 2px tabs with a 44 to 48px target.
Do set Greek display headings in GFS Didot capitals.
Do keep motion to the one reveal grammar and the single hero print, and make both static under reduced motion.
donts: Don't use a full-bleed photo with a dark overlay and a centred script headline.
Don't use glass, backdrop blur, gradients or emoji.
Don't round the frames or panels; large forms take octagonal cuts, never radii.
Don't give printed panels or frames a shadow; shadows are for floating things only.
Don't fill decorative elements with olive; olive means booking.
Don't set paragraphs, prices or form text in Cinzel.
